name: Bird's Opening
summary: 1.f4 stakes a claim on e5 and aims for a flexible, solid setup with the bishop on the long diagonal.

goal.title: Control e5 and build a compact kingside
goal.text: White's f-pawn and knight team up to control e5, the key central square. Behind that, White castles early, fianchettoes the queen's bishop on b2 to eye the long diagonal toward g7, and keeps a solid pawn on e3. The aim is a safe king, a grip on the center from the flank, and the choice of when to strike with d4, c4 or Ne5.
plans: Control e5 with the f-pawn and the knight on f3
Fianchetto the queen's bishop (b3 and Bb2) to pressure the long diagonal
Castle early; keep the pawn on e3 and the bishop on e2
Expand in the center with d3/d4 or c4 once development is complete

variations.name: Main line: 1...d5 (Black builds a classical center)
variations.strategy: Against 1...d5 White develops quietly and aims for a reversed-Dutch structure. Play Nf3, e3, b3 and Bb2, then Be2 and castle. Keep control of e5 and wait for the right moment for Ne5 or d3/Nbd2.

variations.name: From's Gambit: 1...e5 (Black offers a pawn)
variations.strategy: Accept the gambit with 2.fxe5, take back on d6 and develop with Nf3. The structure is open and Black will have quick piece play, so stay calm, develop and use the extra pawn and the half-open f-file once the attack runs out of steam.

variations.name: Vs 1...Nf6: a flexible kingside setup
variations.strategy: Against 1...Nf6 White keeps a compact setup with Nf3, e3, Be2 and short castling, then strikes with d4. Avoid committing the queenside until you see Black's plan.
